instructions.state: No reference has been supplied or reviewed. This template must fail validation.
instructions.location: Copy/adapt only into the prepared ignored workspace; never put source scripts/media in tracked data.
instructions.ranges: Each review range is {start:number,end:number,notes:actual evidence}. Cover 0 to exact metadata seconds without gaps/overlaps.
instructions.audioTracks: For each actual stream, add {stream:number,status:reviewed,sourceSha256,reviewer,reviewedAt,notes,ranges}. All tracks and their entire durations require listening.
instructions.observations: Each entry is {time:number,detail:actual observation,evidence:full-playback|frame|audio-listening}. Every segment requires motion evidence and, if audio is present, listening evidence.
instructions.inferences: Each entry is {claim,basis,confidence:low|medium|high}. Exact gear, optics and color temperature cannot be established from pixels alone.
instructions.speech: Resolve none|spoken|sung|mixed|no-audio-track with evidence. For words use {text,provenance:user-provided,assetSha256} from an actual supplied transcript, not ASR invention.
instructions.transcript: Set verified-user-provided after checking the actual supplied text against listening; otherwise not-needed-no-speech or not-present, with the appropriate shot evidence.
instructions.complete: Set status reviewed and sampling reviewed only after actual inspection. Keep every approval false. Dense review requests must be resolved, not waived.
